hypothesis: Established intraday upward trends persist because information and order flow are incorporated gradually; a longer holding period may leave enough gross continuation to exceed round-trip costs.
economic_failure_conditions: Continuation is absent outside the development period
Observed price movement is too small relative to execution costs
Results rely on one period or a small number of sessions
entry_rule: sma_spread > 0 and macd_signal_gap > 0, both derived from prices available at entry
entry_price_assumption: next available minute open; reject missing expected timestamps rather than fill them
exit_rule: fixed horizon at minute open, with no trade crossing the session cutoff
quote_stress: add the previously observed 32.58272830737331 bps one-way quote scenario; diagnostic only, not calibrated fill evidence
retrospective_independence_warning: These dates may have been used in prior project research; they are generalization diagnostics, not a certified untouched final test.

acceptance.uncertainty_method: session-block bootstrap of equal-initial-notional daily PnL; Bonferroni-adjusted lower confidence bounds for four horizons

decision_rules.retire: all four predeclared horizons fail supported positive net edge or matched baseline improvement on retrospective validation
decision_rules.revise: some evidence survives but coverage, stability, cost robustness, or execution reconciliation remains inadequate; record a new hypothesis before another experiment
decision_rules.continue: a frozen winner passes retrospective criteria and subsequent untouched confirmation with independently adequate execution evidence

stopping_rule: evaluate this fixed grid once; no additional parameter search or threshold relaxation after seeing results
data_policy: verify source content hashes and recompute AAPL calendar completeness; retain the older parent dataset failure and per-symbol quality distinction; overlapping timestamps use the dataset with the latest acquisition end date and conflicting closes are counted
execution_policy: artifact-only reconciliation; no new orders or promotion to manufacture evidence
